entry.name: jit.quat2axis
entry.description: Convert a quaternion (a four-dimensional vector) to an angle-axis representation. Jitter quaternions are ordered X Y Z W.

attributes.name: angleaxis
attributes.digest: Resulting angle-axis
attributes.description: The resulting angle-axis values after the conversion, in the form of angle (in degrees) and an axis.
